_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Shock Management Plan
summary: The Shock Management Plan describes the Contractor's procedures to integrate the shock requirements into the equipment procurement and installation.
description_purpose: The Shock Management Plan describes the Contractor's procedures to integrate the shock requirements into the equipment procurement and installation.
application_interrelationship: This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Shock Management Plan shall be in Contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Shock Management Plan shall include the following sections:

children.title: Purpose and Scope.
children.content: This section shall identify the purpose, scope, and general applicability of the Shock Management Plan. Also, a list of those specifications, standards, manuals, and other documents applicable to the shock management requirements shall be included. The implementation of the Shock Management Plan shall also be included in this section.

children.title: Organization.
children.content: This section shall identify the organization for shock management and shall include:

children.title: Relationships among the project and functional organizations.
Responsibilities and authority for shock management of all participating groups and organizations.
Internal policies and directives relating to shock design.
Provide a sample vendor purchase order/subcontract which contains the shock requirements as invoked.
Shock Requirements Definition.
children.content: This section shall define the responsibilities and requirements as set forth in the ship specifications and contract.

children.title: Installation Design Integration.
children.content: This section shall include the engineering design and installation integration methods to be employed to accomplish the shock requirements of the ship specifications.

children.title: Schedule.
children.content: Schedule of procurement and installation of Grade "A" and "B" equipment and systems.

children.title: Reports.
children.content: Sample shock reports required to be submitted under this contract shall be included.
